fields.label: Qualification
fields.description: Which examination these marks are from. The same option list as Admission Enquiry Education, because Frappe does not support a child table inside a child table - so this is a sibling table tied to the education row by its qualification rather than a nested one

fields.label: Out Of
fields.description: Stored rather than assumed to be 100: boards mark out of 75, 90, 200 and 600, and a rule written as a percentage cannot compare raw marks across them

fields.label: Percentage
fields.description: Derived on save from marks and max marks, so an eligibility rule stated as a percentage has one number to compare and never divides at read time
